title: festuca tunicata f. scabra
intro: Festuca tunicata f. scabra, commonly known as Mountain Fescue, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family (Poaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relieving anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Festuca tunicata f. scabra include sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
